desc.en: Pre-owned camera strap in good overall condition with normal wear from use. Its slim, understated black design provides a lightweight way to carry a camera without the bulk of a traditional wide strap.

en: Slim-profile black strap with a textured center section, adjustable length, and metal clip-style attachments at both ends.
